metadata.case_name: LAI LIN CHI v. A.S. WATSON GROUP (HK) LTD

injuries.description: Chronic Microvascular Ischaemia of bilateral cerebral hemipheres and white matter T2 hyperintensities (possible previous infarcts)
source: A MRI scan of the brain done in February 2014 showed Chronic Microvascular Ischaemia of bilateral cerebral hemipheres and various areas of “hyperintensities” which could be due to “previous infarcts”.
In view of her MRI brain scan report, we offer a long term prophylactic aspirin treatment for her cerebral infarction.

injuries.description: Residual postconcussional syndrome / postconcussional syndrome (diagnosis mentioned in follow-up)
source: She was continued managed having residual postconcussional syndrome. Main symptoms of headache and dizziness remained static.

injuries.description: Soft tissue injury / contusion to her right shoulder
source: she had suffered soft tissue injury / contusion only
soft tissue injury / contusion to her right hip and shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: Soft tissue injury / contusion to her right hip
source: she had suffered soft tissue injury / contusion only
soft tissue injury / contusion to her right hip and shoulder.

manifestations.description: pains (general), including intermittent right hip and buttock pain
intermittent right shoulder pain and weakness
decrease in range of motion of the right shoulder and hip
significant guarding with voluntary resistance with complaint of pain on the right side of the body
psychiatric / psychological problems including low mood and symptoms compatible with adjustment disorder

treatments_received: Attendance at Department of Accident and Emergency, Queen Elizabeth Hospital
treatments_future: Long term prophylactic aspirin treatment for cerebral infarction (offered)
Psychiatric follow-up in public sector: once every 8 weeks at HK$200 per session for the next 9 months (or 6 months after conclusion of litigation) (as accepted by the court)
Clinical psychological treatment in public sector: 2-3 sessions at HK$100 per session (as accepted by the court)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Loss of ability to provide services to the family (caring for grandson and household chores); court allowed 3 months' equivalence of a domestic helper's salary (HK$4,310 x 3 = HK$12,930).
